description: Whether an IPv4 address is a broadcast address for a network interface: all ones, all zeros, or the subnet broadcast of the interface (ip4_addr_isbroadcast_u32)
notes: lwIP 2.2.0, ip4_addr_isbroadcast_u32 (src/core/ipv4/ip4_addr.c). The netif fields become parameters: fl = netif->flags (NETIF_FLAG_BROADCAST = 0x02), ip = interface address, m = netmask; ip4_addr_net_eq, IPADDR_ANY and IPADDR_BROADCAST are inlined. Written by us from the function. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake: two branches, masked compares and a phi: 18 IR instructions. Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
